automationNotes: Per [Managing Webhooks in an App](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/developer-hub/managing-webhooks-in-an-app): open **Developer Hub** → choose an app → left nav **Webhooks**; doc §4 **select the events** — flow clicks **Installed** under **App Events** so manifest **Save** enables (with **URL to Notify**). **Branch-level Scope** / **Branch Event(s)** / **Branch Alias(es) Event(s)** optional for **organization** apps; **Stack Events** optional. `data/dom/Developer-Hub/webhooks.html`.
